sections.title: Summary
sections.body:
**Eleven of the day's 32 commits went into one ticket — PJAN-86 config safety in `pjangler` — and it is still landing fixes, while the report pipeline that tells you this quietly missed 2026-08-26 and all three cron jobs are erroring.**

## What happened

**Config-install safety in `pjangler` was the centre of gravity.** Eleven commits, all `PJAN-86`, all circling the same failure class: `f2d9c65` serialize config bootstrap writers, `ff401fe` preserve concurrent config state, `3756da3` make config install races atomic, `40f72e1` preserve config through validation rollback. Alongside them a Hermes-deploy hardening run — `1776eb5` harden deployment convergence, `8041abd` make deploy outcomes truthful, `1ec073f` pin the reviewed template, `a09bfa6` close review gaps. The day's single recorded decision is here too: *take PJAN-86 as the foreground WIP despite stale started lanes*. Eleven commits on one ticket in one day is either a hard bug being cornered or a fix that keeps not holding.

**`james-brennan` moved the relay off the workstation.** `b2c7734` runs the relay in the account rather than on the workstation, `546db51` removes the workstation's ability to serve Jim's traffic, and `c9bc0e8` (JIMB-163) puts the dispatchers in the relay's task. JIMB-181 built approve-on-the-card end to end across `relay` and `surface` (`439e521`, `38466ff`, `a4eab35`, `cb3d73d`). `ae1e078` fixed a nightly watcher that stopped looking before it reached today. `f0ce8e1` (JIMB-194) documents "the architecture as it actually is, and an honest ledger." Three of the twelve commits are `checkpoint:` auto-commits.

**33GOD and `bloodbank` did architecture on paper.** `f4aefc9` and `6161544` map the full event and command journey in both repos; `6592275` proposes bus-mediated workforce delegation; `15f4265` adds a verified control-surface inventory and corrects an n8n assumption. `ef56dfa` brands the Bloodbank n8n node package.

`intelliforia` shipped two security cleanups — `5ad5b21d` redacts a celery redis log, `9af0dd8e` stops tracking demo env secrets.

## Needs you

- **Report delivery is degraded.** 2026-08-26 has no published report and no staged generation in the archive. Delivered streak is 0. The day is simply gone.
- **All three cron jobs report `last_status='error'`**, including both copies of `delonet-daily-report` — and `33god-pm.bak` shares a cron dir with `33god-pm`, so the same job is registered twice. `delodocs-triage-second-pass` also references two uninstalled skills (`obsidian`, `llm-wiki`).
- **Four gateway units are not running** (`condaleeza` inactive; `delonet-director`, `hermes-agent-pm`, `ssbnk-pm` unknown to systemd), `hermes-drumjangler-pm-heartbeat.timer` has never triggered, and `hermes-tonnybox-pm-consumer.service` is not-found.
- **pr-crusher's tick failed**: provider `opencode_free` returned `blocked`, so `mcp-server-trello` PRs #115 and #111 sat MERGEABLE with passing CI and nothing touched them.
- Repeated ops noise: **`https://get.delo.sh/` returning HTTP 502 and being container-restarted** many times, plus a Tiller failure — service-account key missing at `/app/secrets/tiller-sa-key.json`.

## Worth noting

20 of 26 active projects have no configured git root, so nothing was read for `hindsight`, `ssbnk`, `vinyl`, `litellm` and 16 others despite `hindsight` alone logging 1,257 events and five committing sessions. The commit record is materially incomplete. Also: 16,117 events, 240 sessions, peak 2,938 events at 21:00Z — and exactly one recorded decision.
